results.what: Catalogue of Hilbert's lecture courses (Königsberg to early Göttingen), including the note that a Foundations of Geometry course was prepared but not delivered
results.modern_name: Hilbert's teaching record / list of lecture courses
results.usually_credited_to: David Hilbert (documented in the Hilbert Nachlass, Cod. Ms. Hilbert 600; used by Hallett & Majer 2004 and by Reid's biography)

deep.surprise_reason: This is an administrative list of courses Hilbert taught. It is already known and used by historians, e.g. in Hallett & Majer's edition of the geometry lectures. It contains no mathematical content.
transcription_corrections: Page number at top left is faint; it appears to read '110' rather than '109[?]', consistent with the folio numbering.
The struck-out parenthetical after 'Grundlagen der Geometrie' reads '(nur ausgearbeitet, nicht gelesen)', with 'gelesen' heavily hatched out.
'Integrationsmethod.' is written as 'Integrationsmeth-' with 'od.' squeezed vertically at the margin; read '(nach Cauchys Integrationsmethod. über d. complex. Ebene.)'.
The last six entries (from 'Theorie der analytischen Funktionen' on) are in a different, later cursive hand and ink.
'Grundlagen der Euklidischen Geometrie': the word is written roughly 'Euklidischen' in quick cursive; the transcription is acceptable.
